column1: # A corpus binary whose basename contains <name-substring> is driven with <args> verbatim
# (skipping auto-discovery), the reliable way to exercise tools that need real inputs or
# that only print on stderr. Empty <args> means "run with no arguments". Lines starting
# with '#' are ignored. Curated entries take priority; auto-discovery (--version/-V/
# --help/-h/noargs, stable non-empty stdout) is the fallback.
# Seed entries are verified deterministic-stdout under Wine on the MSYS2 i686 corpus.
# Add more as driveable binaries are confirmed.
